name: Shameka Humphries
quote: Miss Paulette is truly amazing! My son has been going to her daycare since he was 9 months old and she has taken such great care of him. She is truly a gem and just know that your child is in AMAZING hands with her. She's more than a daycare provider; she tries to teach the children and genuinely cares for them. My son is always clean and there are NO issues with anything while he's there. She's the best around. I would recommend her 1000 times over.
